description_en: Queries the host information in a dedicated cluster
description_zh: 查询专属集群内的主机信息
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-dedicated-hosts --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --dedicated-host-group-id dhg-7a9xxxxxxxx --order-id 102565235 --host-type dhg_cloud_ssd --host-status 1 --allocation-status 1 --zone-id cn-hangzhou-i --dedicated-host-id ch-t4nn100ddxxxxxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDedicatedHosts

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以通过接口DescribeRegions查看地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The dedicated cluster ID. You can call the DescribeDedicatedHostGroups operation to query the dedicated cluster ID
parameters.name: dedicated_host_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The storage type of the host. Valid values:
dhg_cloud_ssd: ESSD cloud disk.
dhg_local_ssd: local standard SSD
parameters.help_zh:
主机存储类型。取值：
dhg_cloud_ssd：ESSD云盘。
dhg_local_ssd：SSD本地盘
parameters.name: host_type

parameters.help_en:
The host status. Valid values:
0: being created
1: running
2: down
3: offline (host being replaced)
4: offline
5: deleted
6: restarting
parameters.help_zh:
主机状态。取值：
0：创建中
1：使用中
2：宕机
3：宕机下线（替换主机中）
4：下线
5：删除
6：重启中
parameters.name: host_status

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the host allows instance allocation. Valid values:
0: Instance allocation is not allowed.
1: Instance allocation is allowed
parameters.help_zh:
主机当前是否允许分配实例。取值：
0：不允许分配。
1：允许分配
parameters.name: allocation_status

parameters.help_en: The host ID in the dedicated cluster
parameters.name: dedicated_host_id

AccountName.description_en: The account of the dedicated cluster host. You can call the [CreateDedicatedHostAccount]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196877.html） operation to create an account
AccountName.description_zh: 专属集群主机账号。可通过[CreateDedicatedHostAccount]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196877.html）创建

AllocationStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether the host allows instance allocation. Valid values:
0: Instance allocation is not allowed.
1: Instance allocation is allowed
AllocationStatus.description_zh:
主机当前是否允许分配实例。返回值：
0：不允许分配
1：允许分配

CPUAllocationRatio.description_en: The CPU overcommit ratio of the dedicated cluster. Unit: %. For more information about the overcommit ratio, see [Cluster management]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/182328.html）
CPUAllocationRatio.description_zh: 当前专属集群的CPU超配比。单位：%。关于超配比的更多信息，请参见[管理集群]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/182328.html）

CpuUsed.description_en: The number of CPU cores used on the host. Unit: cores
CpuUsed.description_zh: 主机CPU已使用核数。单位：个

CreatedTime.description_en: The time when the host was created

DiskAllocationRatio.description_en: The disk space overcommit ratio of the dedicated cluster. Unit: %. For more information about the overcommit ratio, see [Cluster management]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/182328.html）
DiskAllocationRatio.description_zh: 当前专属集群的磁盘空间超配比。单位：%。关于超配比的更多信息，请参见[管理集群]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/182328.html）

EndTime.description_en: The expiration time of the host

Engine.description_en: The database engine of the instance

HostCPU.description_en: The total number of CPU cores on the host. Unit: cores

HostMem.description_en: The total memory of the host. Unit: MB

HostStatus.description_en:
The host status. Valid values:
0: being created
1: running
2: down
3: offline (host being replaced)
4: offline
5: deleted
6: restarting
HostStatus.description_zh:
主机状态。返回值：
0：创建中
1：使用中
2：宕机
3：宕机下线（替换主机中）
4：下线
5：删除
6：重启中

HostStorage.description_en: The storage capacity of the host. Unit: MB

HostType.description_en:
The storage type of the host. Valid values:
dhg_cloud_ssd: ESSD cloud disk.
dhg_local_ssd: local standard SSD
HostType.description_zh:
主机存储类型。返回值：
dhg_cloud_ssd：ESSD云盘。
dhg_local_ssd：SSD本地盘

IPAddress.description_en: The internal IP address of the host

ImageCategory.description_en:
The host image. This parameter is returned only when the Engine parameter is set to mssql. Valid values:
WindowsWithMssqlStdLicense: Windows with SQL Server Standard Edition license.
WindowsWithMssqlEntLisence: Windows with SQL Server Enterprise Edition license.
WindowsWithMssqlWebLisence: Windows with SQL Server Web Edition license
ImageCategory.description_zh:
主机镜像。仅在Engine参数为mssql时返回。返回值：
WindowsWithMssqlStdLicense：Windows（含SQL Server标准版License）。
WindowsWithMssqlEntLisence：Windows（含SQL Server企业版License）。
WindowsWithMssqlWebLisence：Windows（含SQL ServerWeb版License）

InstanceNumber.description_en: The total number of instances on the host

MemAllocationRatio.description_en: The maximum memory usage of each host in the host group
MemAllocationRatio.description_zh: 主机组中每台主机的内存最大使用率

MemoryUsed.description_en: The amount of memory used. Unit: MB

OpenPermission.description_en:
The OS permission status of the host. Valid values:
0 or null: Cannot be enabled.
1: Can be enabled.
3: Enabled
OpenPermission.description_zh:
主机OS权限开放状态。返回值：
0或者null：不可开放。
1：可开放。
3：已开放

VPCId.description_en: The virtual private cloud (VPC) ID of the host
VPCId.description_zh: 主机所属专有网络VPC ID

VSwitchId.description_en: The vSwitch ID of the host

ZoneId.description_en: The zone ID of the host
